summary_en: Mipox raised its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 from 28 yen to 32 yen per share, reflecting improved business performance.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast for the Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Mipox Corporation announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company raised its dividend per share from the previously announced 28 yen to 32 yen, representing a 4 yen increase. This adjustment reflects improved earnings prospects, as the company also revised upward its full-year business performance forecasts. The higher dividend underscores management's confidence in the company's operational results and commitment to returning earnings to shareholders.
